messages:
Alex Chen: quick spike — running through dark mode palette nits for Console v2. want to lock tokens before devs start implementing. thoughts on surface vs elevated surface?
Marta Lopez: +1 to locking. i still feel current surface is too blue-ish on 14" macs. feels colder than intended.
Priya Nair: can you post screenshots with isolated panels? lighting makes a difference. also we need to check text contrast on tiny labels in the model dropdown.
Alex Chen: uploaded — see attachments (screenshot 1/2). main worry: `--color-surface` (#0F1720) with `--text-muted` (#6B6B6B) is 3.9:1 per DesignBot. that's below 4.5:1 for body small text.
DesignBot: Contrast check: `#6B6B6B` on `#0F1720` = 3.9:1 — fails WCAG AA for normal text. Recommend `#8F9AA3` (4.6:1) or lighten surface slightly to `#111826`.
Samir Patel: prefer keeping surface dark but increase muted text luminance. lighter muted looks OK next to primary text.
Marta Lopez: can we keep primary copy at pure white? `#FFFFFF` on `#0F1720` is fine. i vote for `--text-muted: #8F9AA3`.
Priya Nair: agree. also syntax highlighting: current theme uses desaturated green for keywords — it disappears for some color-blind palettes. Suggest changing keyword color to `#66D9EF` (cyan) and functions to `#FFD580` (soft orange) — better separation.
Alex Chen: note for monaco/theme: we'll need to update highlight groups: keyword, function, string, type. example config snippet:
```css
--color-surface: #0F1720;
--text-primary: #FFFFFF;
--text-muted: #8F9AA3;
--code-keyword: #66D9EF;
--code-fn: #FFD580;
```
Marta Lopez: charts — current palette uses purple-y reds, which clash with alerts. recommend swapping to a more neutral categorical palette: teal, indigo, amber, rose. also make first three colors >= 3:1 contrast on surface for tiny tooltips.
DesignBot: Chart contrast audit: teal (#2EC4B6) vs surface is 4.2:1, indigo (#5B61FF) is 3.6:1 — indigo slightly low for small text overlays. Consider `#4B52E6` for indigo (4.0:1).
Samir Patel: for sparkline strokes, 2px on hover, 1px baseline. ensure semantics: success = teal, warning = amber, error = rose. not tied to red/pink that we use for destructive actions.
Priya Nair: accessibility nit — focus ring color in dark mode is currently `#1F7AFC` but on dark surface it's too saturated; can we use `--focus-ring: rgba(94,147,255,0.9)` and slightly thicker (`3px`) for keyboard nav contrast?
Alex Chen: noted. also copy tweak: in the theme switcher, change label from "Enable dark mode" to "Dark appearance" (toggle) — avoids implied opt-in language.
Marta Lopez: +1 on copy. tiny: use sentence case for dropdown items (e.g., "Dark appearance")
DesignBot: Accessibility checklist updated: (1) text muted >= 4.5:1 for body small, (2) chart primary colors >= 3:1 for micro labels, (3) focus ring visible at 3px min, (4) syntax groups distinguishable for deuteranopia.
Samir Patel: i'll prototype updated tokens in storybook tonight and post links here. want final decisions by EOD so infra can land CSS variables.
Alex Chen: thanks all. next steps: Samir to post storybook link by 6pm PT, Priya to run keyboard-only walkthrough on the new palette, Marta to finalize copy strings. i'll collate final token list and share a PR template for engineers. :thumbsup:
